_totalSupply storage variable holding the whole token supply.

SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): performs a + b with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): performs a - b with underflow require.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): performs a * b with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): performs a / b with divide-by-zero require.
Owned constructor: assigns msg.sender to owner.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) restricted to onlyOwner, sets newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): caller must equal newOwner, then owner is updated.
onlyOwner modifier performing require(msg.sender == owner).
AlbinoShibaInu constructor: sets token metadata, supply and pre-credits a fixed address.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves tokens and reduces allowance.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls external receiveApproval.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts, rejecting plain ETH.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token address.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for balances, allowed and ownership checks.
Unchecked addition c = a + b inside SafeMath.safeAdd.
Unchecked subtraction c = a - b inside SafeMath.safeSub.
Unchecked multiplication c = a * b inside SafeMath.safeMul.
Division c = a / b inside SafeMath.safeDiv.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored directly as owner in the Owned constructor (access control initialization).
msg.sender flows into the Owned constructor body to set the owner.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside the onlyOwner require.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner require check.
onlyOwner gate guards transferOwnership execution.
onlyOwner gate guards transferAnyERC20Token execution.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
msg.sender must equal newOwner before acceptOwnership completes.
Constructor initializes the _totalSupply state variable.
Constructor credits the fixed address inside the balances mapping.
msg.sender indexes balances in the transfer subtraction.
balances[msg.sender] is read before being subtracted in transfer.
tokens parameter is subtracted from the sender balance.
safeSub result is written back into the balances mapping in transfer.
to parameter indexes balances in the transfer addition.
tokens parameter is added to the recipient balance.
safeAdd result is written back into the balances mapping in transfer.
to parameter is used by the transfer function body and Transfer event.
transfer invokes safeSub for balance arithmetic.
transfer invokes safeAdd for balance arithmetic.
msg.sender is used as the first key of the allowed mapping in approve/approveAndCall.
spender parameter is written as key in allowed during approve.
tokens parameter is written as value in allowed during approve.
from parameter indexes balances in the transferFrom subtraction.
tokens parameter is subtracted from the from balance.
safeSub result is written into balances in transferFrom.
balances[from] is read inside transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping in the transferFrom allowance subtraction.
tokens parameter is subtracted from the spender allowance.
safeSub result is written into the allowed mapping in transferFrom.
allowed[from][msg.sender] is read before the allowance subtraction.
to parameter indexes balances in the transferFrom addition.
tokens parameter is added to the recipient balance.
safeAdd result is written into balances in transferFrom.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for balance and allowance arithmetic.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd for recipient balance arithmetic.
spender parameter is written as key in allowed during approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is written as value in allowed during approveAndCall.
allowed state is updated before the external receiveApproval call, enabling reentrancy.
msg.sender is forwarded as an argument to the external receiveApproval call.
spender parameter defines the callee of the external receiveApproval call.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
The callee contract can call back into approveAndCall or other token functions.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an arbitrary spender contract.
tokenAddress parameter defines the callee of the external ERC20 transfer call.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
owner state variable is the recipient argument of the external ERC20 transfer call.
An arbitrary token contract is called and can re-enter the token contract.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to a caller-supplied token address.
_totalSupply is an operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply.
balances[address(0)] is an operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply.
totalSupply returns the result of an unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balances value is returned by balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
allowed value is returned by allowance.
parameter a is an operand of the a + b addition in safeAdd.
parameter b is an operand of the a + b addition in safeAdd.
parameter a is an operand of the a - b subtraction in safeSub.
parameter b is an operand of the a - b subtraction in safeSub.
parameter a is an operand of the a * b multiplication in safeMul.
parameter b is an operand of the a * b multiplication in safeMul.
parameter a is an operand of the a / b division in safeDiv.
parameter b is the divisor in safeDiv.
safeAdd body executes the raw addition that relies on a require guard.
safeSub body executes the raw subtraction that relies on a require guard.
safeMul body executes the raw multiplication that relies on a require guard.
safeDiv body executes the division that relies on a require guard.

tokens is only meaningful as the amount argument of transfer.
spender is only meaningful as the allowance key argument of approve.
